_what: #87 phase 1 / #80: the pointwise grading worksheet. Section 'blind' covers the 60 sealed blind answers (decode_out/ten-task/blind/answers.md) graded WITHOUT the id map; section 'supplement_A-crow-32k' covers the 30 answers of the A-crow-32k arm, which is NOT part of the sealed blind set (it was generated after the seal was written) and is graded non-blind, arm identity known by construction.
_how: Every requirement of decode_out/ten-task/checklist.json scored met/partly/not with a one-line justification. share_met = mean with met 1.0, partly 0.5, not 0.0. verdict: pass = all met, fail = nothing met (all empty answers land here), partial = between. Empty answers carry the justification 'empty answer - no content produced...' on every requirement.
_order: The 'blind' grades were fixed in full BEFORE idmap.json was opened and BEFORE the A-crow-32k answers were read. Byte-identities between 32k answers and blind answers (same engine, same seed) were only compared AFTER the blind grades were fixed; identical texts received identical grades.

_verified_extras.cmake_syntax: The two 32k t5-agent one-liner command lines that mix configure and build options were executed against cmake 4.4.3 with a dummy project: both forms exit with 'Unknown argument --target/--parallel'; the two-step form (configure, then cmake --build <dir> --target server) exits 0.
_verified_extras.t6b_latex: The runner's mechanical number matcher does not recognise LaTeX '{,}' thousands separators (1{,}610{,}612{,}736); two blind t6b answers report every value correctly but were marked missing by the mechanical check. Graded by reading.
